# arifOS Observatory — Constitutional Governance Dashboard
# https://arifos.arif-fazil.com

> Constitutional governance observatory for the arifOS federation. Real-time organ health, floor scores, vault status, and federation topology.

## What This Is

arifOS is a constitutional AI governance framework. This observatory provides read-only visibility into the federation:
- **6 Federation Organs**: arifOS (kernel), GEOX (earth), WEALTH (capital), WELL (vitality), AAA (A2A hub), A-FORGE (execution)
- **13 Constitutional Floors**: F1 AMANAH through F13 SOVEREIGN
- **VAULT999**: Immutable audit chain with hash-chained seals
- **888 JUDGE**: Constitutional verdict engine

## Canonical MCP Gateway

All public MCP traffic routes through one canonical gateway:

| Endpoint | Method | Domain | Description |
|----------|--------|--------|-------------|
| `/mcp` | POST | `mcp.arif-fazil.com` | MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 (streamable-http) |
| `/tools.json` | GET | `mcp.arif-fazil.com` | Available MCP tools |
| `/sse` | GET | `mcp.arif-fazil.com` | Server-sent events |

## Observatory Read-Only Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Domain | Description |
|----------|--------|--------|-------------|
| `/health` | GET | `arifos.arif-fazil.com` | Observatory health |
| `/api/status` | GET | `arifos.arif-fazil.com` | Federation status |
| `/federation-manifest.json` | GET | `arifos.arif-fazil.com` | Federation topology manifest |
